body:
## Problem

Ground truth: `packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js` (era `ryan-van-poederooyen-2002-devin-townsend-band`, lines ~19527-19587) says Devin Townsend recruited Ryan Van Poederooyen in **2002** on Gene Hoglan's recommendation, with his first recorded album being **"Accelerated Evolution" (2003)**. This exact 1999-vs-2002 conflict was already identified and closed as resolved-via-external-research in **#8011** ("Resolved #8011 (Van Poederooyen join-year conflict) via Wikipedia, promoted to ai-fix" — commit `b5de0d30`), which updated `drummerEvolution.js` to the verified 2002/Accelerated-Evolution answer. However #8011's own "Verify: all three files agree" step was never executed — only `drummerEvolution.js` was fixed. Two sibling files still assert the old, now-disproven 1999/Terria claim:

- `packages/frontend/data/extendedBios.js`:
  - Line ~6788 (overview): "...primary drummer for Devin Townsend and his various projects **since 1999**."
  - Line ~6803 (careerHighlights): `{ year: '1999', event: 'Began collaboration with Devin Townsend' }` and `{ year: '2001', event: 'Recorded "Terria" with Devin Townsend...' }`
  - Line ~6865 (trivia): "Has played on nearly every Devin Townsend solo and band album **since 1999**"
  - Line ~6885-6886 (FAQ): "...primary drummer **since 1999**, including the Devin Townsend Project era..." and "...appearing on nearly every solo and band album **since 1999** — including 'Terria' (2001)..."
- `packages/frontend/data/soundLikeGuides.js`:
  - Line ~16002: "Ryan Van Poederooyen has been Devin Townsend's drummer **since 1999**"
  - Line ~16008 (keyPoints): "Devin Townsend's drummer **since 1999** — one of prog-metal's longest-running partnerships"

## Fix

Replace every "since 1999" / "began in 1999" / "Terria (2001)" claim in these two files with the verified 2002 recruitment + "Accelerated Evolution" (2003) debut, matching `drummerEvolution.js`'s already-corrected wording. Where a "25+ year" / "25-plus year" tenure-length phrase depends on the 1999 start date, recompute from 2002 (Townsend relationship is ~23 years as of 2026, not 25+). Remove the "Terria" (2001) album credit from the career-highlights/FAQ lists (Terria predates his 2002 joining) — do not just swap the year on that entry, drop it since Van Poederooyen did not play on it.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "since 1999\|Terria" packages/frontend/data/extendedBios.js | grep -i "van poederooyen\|ryan"` returns nothing in the fixed section (verify by reading the surrounding Ryan Van Poederooyen block, not a blind grep across the whole file).
2. `grep -n "since 1999" packages/frontend/data/soundLikeGuides.js` — the Ryan Van Poederooyen guide section no longer contains it.
3. Both files' 2002/Accelerated Evolution (2003) wording matches `drummerEvolution.js`'s era block exactly (same recruiting year, same debut album).
4. No new file created; URLs unchanged (additive-refresh only, per CLAUDE.md rule 4).

## Done

Ryan Van Poederooyen's join year and debut album are consistent across `drummerEvolution.js`, `extendedBios.js`, and `soundLikeGuides.js` — all say 2002 / "Accelerated Evolution" (2003), matching the Wikipedia-verified answer from closed issue #8011.
title: SEO: Ryan Van Poederooyen — extendedBios.js/soundLikeGuides.js still say 'since 1999'/Terria(2001), contradicts the already-researched 2002 recruitment
